title: Disable Win+X Power Shortcuts
name: disable-winx-power-shortcuts
description: Remove the Shut down, Restart, Sleep, Hibernate, and Sign out commands from the Win+X menu to prevent accidental or prank power actions.
deepDescription: This tweak removes the entire "Shut down or sign out" submenu (Shutdown/Restart/Sleep/Hibernate/Sign out) from the Win+X power user menu, Start menu power button, and Ctrl+Alt+Del screen, so pressing Win+X, U, then U/R/S/H/I does nothing. It restarts Explorer to apply immediately and is a reversible, safe registry change.
modal: This tweak removes the power and sign-out options from the Win+X menu to stop accidental or prank shutdowns/restarts/sign-outs. Explorer will restart to apply it. It can be reverted safely.
